title: The Missing Diamond
subtitle: Blackwood Mansion, a private party, and an empty case
briefing: The Blackwood family is hosting a private celebration. The Blackwood Diamond, valued at around two million dollars, sits in a protected exhibition case. At 10:15 PM it is confirmed present. At 10:45 PM a member of staff finds the case open and the stone gone. There is no forced entry, and only a handful of people had access to that wing of the house.
solution: Sophia Miller left the dining hall at 10:26 PM, used a panel code she had memorised while filing Mr Blackwood's insurance paperwork, and opened the display without triggering an alarm. A button tore from her coat as she reached into the case. The camera outage that made Marcus Reed look guilty was an automated firmware restart, scheduled months earlier and pure coincidence.

topics.last_saw: when they last saw the diamond

suspects.name: Adrian Blackwood
suspects.motive: Carries significant private debt and knows exactly what the stone is worth.

statements.question: Where were you at 10:30 PM?
statements.text: In the dining hall, arguing with my father about money. Half the room heard it.

statements.question: When did you last see the diamond?
statements.text: Before dinner. I walked guests past the case at eight.

statements.question: Do you know the code for the display panel?
statements.text: No. My father never trusted me with it, which tells you something.

suspects.name: Sophia Miller
suspects.motive: Was told last week that her contract would not be renewed.

statements.question: Where were you at 10:30 PM?
statements.text: In the dining room. I did not leave it once between ten and the alarm.

statements.question: When did you last see the diamond?
statements.text: At quarter past ten. I checked the room before the toast.

statements.question: Do you know the code for the display panel?
statements.text: Certainly not. That is Mr Reed's department, not mine.

statements.question: Is there a button missing from your coat?
statements.text: I really could not say. Coats lose buttons. Is that a crime now?

suspects.name: Marcus Reed
suspects.motive: Understands the alarm system better than anyone in the building.

statements.question: Where were you at 10:30 PM?
statements.text: In the security room watching the feeds go dark one after another.

statements.question: When did you last see the diamond?
statements.text: On the monitor at ten fifteen. Then the corridor camera dropped.

statements.question: Do you know the code for the display panel?
statements.text: Of course I do. So does the insurer, and so does the file it is written in.

suspects.name: Elena Stone
suspects.motive: Made two private offers for the diamond in the last year, both refused.

statements.question: Where were you at 10:30 PM?
statements.text: Talking to the Hallorans by the window. Ask them, they never stop talking.

statements.question: When did you last see the diamond?
statements.text: At eight, with everyone else. I have seen it a hundred times.

locations.name: Exhibition Room
locations.description: The display case stands open. There is no broken glass and no mark on the lock.

searchables.label: Examine the display case
searchables.flavour: The lid is undamaged. Whoever opened this was invited to.

searchables.label: Search the floor
searchables.flavour: You go over the carpet on your hands and knees.

searchables.label: Inspect the access panel
searchables.flavour: The keypad is clean. Too clean, in fact.

searchables.label: Search the nearby furniture
searchables.flavour: Behind the console table, dust and one clear print.

locations.name: Security Room
locations.description: Six monitors, one of them showing a grey rectangle where the corridor should be.

searchables.label: Check the system maintenance record
searchables.flavour: A scheduled task, months old, buried in the maintenance list.

locations.name: Dining Hall
locations.description: Forty covers, half-finished wine, and nobody willing to say who left the room.

searchables.label: Speak to the guests
searchables.flavour: One of the waiting staff remembers more than the guests do.

locations.name: Guest Corridor
locations.description: The connecting passage between the dining hall and the exhibition wing.

searchables.label: Examine the carpet runner
searchables.flavour: A thread of grey wool caught on the brass stair rod.

locations.name: Main Entrance
locations.description: The front of the house, where the caterers came and went all evening.

searchables.label: Check the arrivals register
searchables.flavour: Everyone signed in. Nobody signed out early.

evidence.name: Broken silver button
evidence.description: A small silver button, torn rather than dropped, found beside the display.

evidence.name: Partial fingerprint
evidence.description: A partial print lifted from the underside of the console table.

evidence.name: Undamaged case lock
evidence.description: The display lock was opened with the correct code, not forced.

evidence.name: Grey wool fibre
evidence.description: A short grey fibre on the carpet directly under the case.

evidence.name: Camera outage log
evidence.description: The corridor camera stopped recording at 10:24 PM.

evidence.name: Firmware restart record
evidence.description: The outage was an automated firmware restart scheduled in March.

evidence.name: Waiter's statement
evidence.description: A waiter saw Sophia leave the dining hall shortly after ten twenty.

evidence.name: Panel access record
evidence.description: The panel was opened at 10:31 PM using Mr Blackwood's stored code.

evidence.name: Thread on the stair rod
evidence.description: Grey wool snagged on brass, at coat height, in the corridor.

evidence.name: Adrian's debt notice
evidence.description: A final demand addressed to Adrian, dated three weeks ago.

evidence.name: Insurance file annotation
evidence.description: Sophia's handwriting appears beside the stored panel code in the insurance file.

timeline.text: The party moves through to dinner.
The diamond is confirmed in the display.
The exhibition corridor camera stops recording.
Sophia is seen leaving the dining hall.
The exhibition access panel is opened.
Marcus attempts to restart the camera.
Sophia returns to the dining area.

hints: Compare the statements against the timeline between 10:20 and 10:35.
The camera outage may not have been caused by a person at all.
Somebody wrote the panel code down. Find out who read that file.
